argv:
set -o pipefail; sonar-scanner -Dsonar.scanner.skipJreProvisioning=true -Dsonar.projectBaseDir=/usr/src -Dproject.settings=/out/properties -Dsonar.scanner.metadataFilePath=/tmp/report-task.txt 2>&1 | (ulimit -f 8192; cat > /scanner-log); statuses=(${PIPESTATUS[@]}); metadata_bytes=0; metadata_over_limit=0; if test -f /tmp/report-task.txt; then metadata_bytes=$(head -c 65537 /tmp/report-task.txt | wc -c); test "$metadata_bytes" -le 65536 || metadata_over_limit=1; fi; printf '
--CIX-SCANNER-STATUS--
scanner=%s
sink=%s
metadata_bytes=%s
metadata_over_limit=%s
--CIX-SCANNER-REPORT-TASK--
' "${statuses[0]}" "${statuses[1]}" "$metadata_bytes" "$metadata_over_limit" >> /scanner-log; test "$metadata_bytes" -eq 0 || head -c 65537 /tmp/report-task.txt >> /scanner-log; exit "${statuses[0]}"

contract.docker_log_driver: none; scanner stdout/stderr flows through the bounded log-sink
contract.jre: image Java 21; scanner JRE provisioning disabled with -Dsonar.scanner.skipJreProvisioning=true
contract.report_mount: /out:ro; the only writable evidence paths are two pre-created, size-bounded file binds

scanner_evidence.writer: 8 MiB RLIMIT log-sink, then shell metadata copy after a 65537-byte check

docker_cp.reason: stopped-container tmpfs was unrecoverable in probe-v6; bounded file binds retain both artifacts before exit
